messages:
alex: Quick async — daily checkin on kernel batching + KV warmup. What I did: landed microbatch slotting fix (PR #4237), reran KV-evict sim across 3 shards. Blocker: seeing a p95 regression on long-tail sequences after the kernel change (~+40%). Today: instrument more traces, try toggling the new kernel flag, add a small repro to the PR, and coordinate fallback route if needed. logs/snippet below.

priya: Saw the spike in the dashboard. Which workload/test is this? Is it inference long-seq jobs or internal perf harness? Can you paste the p95 numbers? Also try disabling the kernel feature flag to confirm.

sam: Quick numbers from my local runs (same harness alex used): runA p50=17.8ms p95=119.6ms p99=228ms; runB p50=18.2ms p95=121.0ms p99=235ms; baseline (old kernel) p95≈85ms. Looks like KV slot boundary thrash — cache churn causes extra bursts. No repro script in the PR yet.

alex: thanks. minimal repro command I used:
```
# repro harness (local)
python infra/bench/run_inference.py --model redwood-v2 --seq_len 2048 --concurrency 8 --runs 3
# tail of log:
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] p50=17.8ms p95=119.6ms p99=228ms
[2026-03-18 09:14:12] p50=18.2ms p95=121.0ms p99=235ms
```
I'll add the script to the PR.

jen: Pinged to review #4237. I'll take it after this async. Please add a short repro and a note about the kernel flag so QA can toggle quickly. Also any unit tests covering the slot updates?

matt: I can pair at 14:00 PT for eviction logic. Quick idea: try setting kv.prefetch_window=8 or bump eviction hysteresis to reduce slot handoff frequency as a fast mitigation. Also check whether atomic slot updates are using the new fast-path — that was changed last sprint.

ci-bot: Build/CI for PR #4237: linux/gpu passed, unit tests passed. microbench job queued (job id: bench-9843).

alex: copying notes — I'll add the repro and try prefetch_window=8 locally. If the regression persists, plan for routing fallback to kernel v1.2 for affected customers and add a canary that routes 5% traffic to old kernel. Also will include perf traces in the PR.

sam: left inline comments on the PR re: atomic slot update ordering. Small suggestion: wrap the slot update in a metrics scope so we can count handoffs per-second during bench.

jen: :thumbsup: good plan. If you need me to review the canary rollout policy, tag me in the PR.

alex: will do. blocking ask: if someone can sanity-check the bench job output once queued (bench-9843), ping here. Thanks!
